The reasoning chains indicating the ulnar nerve's involvement are consistent with anatomical knowledge, as the ulnar nerve innervates the little finger. Therefore, the most likely area of loss of sensation in this patient is the palmar surface of the little finger, supported by the consensus that the ulnar nerve primarily affects this region.
